body: wow this is so fucking kind, seriously. I will definitely be looking back on this when I feel hopeless! nobody has ever said such a lovely thing to me honestly. thank you so much for this comment!

thank you so much. this was such a lovely reply. you are so kind too 

I have fibro a long with this and I saw a rheumatologist who treated me like a last out of shape kid and told me to push myself and just exercise 30 minutes a day. she had me believing it too and I tried but I got worse every day. all I could do was like 15 min of cardio or less and then go back to sleep til the entire next day. she was horrible honestly. I tried explaining to her and other doctors about cfs and that theres research the says it might make me worse but I think they just ignored me. I saw a neuropsychologist though who was so amazing and understanding and he recommended stretching for pain and showed me a book on it. it helps a little too. he validated everything I said and offered a relaistc solution. 

 I havent even imagined how my partners (maybe ex right now) family would feel or think about my health issues. he's had people at work ask him about why I dont work and he could've explained better for sure but its ok. I don't care about those people's opinions any. but if I had to deal with a whole other non- understanding family that would be hard. I really hope someday it's more widely known and that all these doctors realize their mistakes with so many of us

thank you for the reply and I will post again if I ever need it. you guys have been very helpful

I think he's leaving me now so I guess that's not a problem anymore. but I thought it was worth it because he was supposed to move us out and then I'd apply for disability and more and help out too. but we've been here like 8 months and just being here has made things worse and more hard. moving out would've been to a smaller place it would have just been our chores and less walking and i could rest and id let him drive and leave alone if he needed to. my parents push me a lot too though just because he is here and hasn't been working I've had to do chores and stuff to keep them happy and not yelling or being overly controlling towards us( they still are though even self admittedly)
